{{Quote|On Kuan, we say, 'Curiosity killed the rondat...''"<br />"''Don't be a rondat, then..|Maarek Stele and Trace|<ref name="TIE Fighter: The Official Strategy Guide">''[[TIE Fighter: The Official Strategy Guide]]''</ref>}}
A '''''Rondat''''' is a animal native to [[Kuan]]. When [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Hamo Blastwell|Trace]] was reciting a proverb about curiosity killing some creature, [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] mentioned a rondat, to which Trace suggested the rondat before dismissing him.
